    | text      = But at the same time, there's part of the prophecy that the Lisan al-Gaib has to be
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:24.800
    | text      = the child of the mother.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:27.480
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:28.480
    | text      = What's it called?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:31.800
    | text      = In the Fremen, it's the Sayyidina.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:34.360
    | text      = In the Ben of Jezerit, it's a reverend mother.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:36.079
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:37.079
    | text      = It's the reverend mother is the mother of the Lisan al-Gaib.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:40.879
    | text      = So he's forcing this prophecy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:44.160
    | text      = He goes to Jessica and is like, we could kill you unless you do this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:50.439
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:51.439
    | text      = We have to make this prophecy come true that I believe in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:54.319
    | text      = There's faith, but there's also a cynicism that he's expressing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:57.759
    | text      = I found that to be very interesting because Javier Bardem is a great actor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:02.240
    | text      = And I think he was able to embody some of that, like, I believe in this prophecy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:10.399
    | text      = You doing this will work with that prophecy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:14.160
    | text      = You not doing this means that it's not you and I could just kill you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:18.879
    | text      = He knows he's strong-arming her.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:20.720
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:21.720
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:22.720
    | text      = But we also find out later on that this is not the first time he believes he's seen the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:26.620
    | text      = Lisan al-Gaib.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:27.959
    | text      = Seen some signs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:28.959
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:29.959
    | text      = So people are kind of wary of him just throwing out, oh great, it's another Messiah from Stilgar
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:35.079
    | text      = again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:36.079
    | text      = Right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:37.079
    | text      = So I'm sure he has that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:38.079
    | text      = And you're right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:39.079
    | text      = I think he plays that really well of being like, hey, listen, I believe in this stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:42.680
    | text      = But at the end of the day, I am a politician.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:45.279
    | text      = And if I go back to them and I say, she doesn't want to be part of anything, they're going
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:48.639
    | text      = to be like, well, then put her in the lake.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:50.139
    | text      = You know what I'm saying?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:51.139
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:52.139
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:53.139
    | text      = You're not useful to us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.139
    | text      = You're an outsider.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:55.139
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:56.139
    | text      = And if you want to save your life, you will help me bring about this prophecy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:00.639
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:01.639
    | text      = And that is such an interesting line of faith because it is well presented, I think, because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:09.920
    | text      = of the quality of acting and because the story has so much time to breathe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:15.000
    | text      = But that like tension of, I don't doubt that he believes he's a true believer, but he's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:20.639
    | text      = also acting incredibly cynically in order to force things that would reinforce and prop
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:25.839
    | text      = up the belief.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:27.199
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:28.199
    | text      = I think that's an interesting point because that's a major theme.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.639
    | text      = The idea of how much is it faith and how much is it like, you've got no choice but to do
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:37.879
    | text      = this to live.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:39.660
    | text      = You know, all of the, all of the Bene Gesserit, these are signs, these are things that are
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:44.120
    | text      = happening are also places where it eventually points down to like, either you do this or
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:49.600
    | text      = you die.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:50.600
    | text      = So is it faith or is it that if you don't fulfill this prophecy, you're just going to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:54.360
    | text      = die anyways?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:55.360
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:56.360
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:57.360
    | text      = And then eventually someone will come along who-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:58.360
    | text      = Will do what we told them to do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:59.360
    | text      = Takes the choice of not dying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:00.759
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:01.759
    | text      = And that will be fulfillment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:02.759
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:03.759
    | text      = So the question then is like, how much agency even does the person who has the ultimate
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:07.759
    | text      = agency have?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:08.759
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:09.759
    | text      = None.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:10.759
    | text      = In a way, in a way, and I would believe that if there weren't magic powers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:16.720
    | text      = There is that problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:17.879
    | text      = That is a part that like, the fact that everyone, like not everyone, but a lot of people could
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:22.120
    | text      = do some really magical shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:23.600
    | text      = Oh yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:24.600
    | text      = Like, if that didn't exist and this was just a very human story, but on another planet-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:29.639
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:30.639
    | text      = You know, like then the cynicism of like, no one really has free will would make more
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:37.879
    | text      = sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:38.879
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:39.879
    | text      = But there's, I mean, free will is already a completely fucked up conversation with the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:42.159
    | text      = existence of the voice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.279
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:44.679
    | text      = Without magic powers, period.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:46.000
    | text      = Well, if the Ben and Jezeret can just force you to do something by speaking, then what
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:51.759
    | text      = existence is there of free will?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:53.519
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:54.519
    | text      = So if you ever be sure anyone is doing anything, if they're around a Ben and Jezeret and you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:59.120
    | text      = know they can do that, then you can never trust anything that that person around them
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.919
    | text      = is doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:03.919
    | text      = But if you see them doing it, they do seem to walk like robots whenever they're doing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:09.039
    | text      = something that the voice told them to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:10.559
    | text      = It does feel that way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:12.080
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.080
    | text      = There is a aesthetic, doot, doot, doot, doot, doot, to how they act.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:18.120
    | text      = That was a big failing the Ben and Jezeret had whenever they created the voice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:21.320
    | text      = They forgot to do the thing where people didn't act.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:23.679
    | text      = Yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:24.679
    | text      = Act natural.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:25.679
    | text      = Act natural.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.679
    | text      = Act like you didn't get the voice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:31.519
    | text      = You can tweak that over time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:33.799
    | text      = But yeah, that is a really challenging question.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:39.840
    | text      = And I think on some levels, I'm not really prepared to answer a lot of it because the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:43.700
    | text      = story still isn't fucking told.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:46.799
    | text      = I thought by the end of this, I would have a much clearer picture of a lot of stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:51.120
    | text      = And to some extent, I think I do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:52.840
    | text      = I think the political intrigue in a lot of it makes a lot more sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:56.519
    | text      = A lot of that stuff is, well, one stage of it makes more sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:02.080
    | text      = But then we're revealed that there's a whole nother level on top of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.799
    | text      = Right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:05.799
    | text      = But you got the idea that whenever Harkonnen was like, the emperor's coming, you got the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.759
    | text      = idea that he sent that message to all the other great houses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.000
    | text      = If he's coming for us, then we have to get them to fight on our side against the emperor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:21.960
    | text      = There was that little moment of trying to explain the political balance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:26.720
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:27.720
    | text      = I still don't fully understand it, but I understand that that layer exists.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:33.159
    | text      = That there is some sort of check on power of the emperor that is the alliance of these
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:39.120
    | text      = great houses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:40.500
    | text      = But at the same time, the emperor ostensibly rules over the great houses and everything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:47.879
    | text      = But ultimately, that is a Trump card that Harkonnen is trying to pull out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:52.600
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.600
    | text      = I mean, part of the political intrigue behind that is from actual, what would I say?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:04.220
    | text      = Any dictator doesn't lead as a dictator.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:07.580
    | text      = There is a certain amount of- The aristocracy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:11.080
    | text      = Yeah, just a fewer number of people you have to try and convince to do shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:14.639
    | text      = You know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.639
    | text      = Instead of trying to- Or oligarchs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.639
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.639
    | text      = You're going to have to get this person who has enough power to cause at least a problem
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:22.679
    | text      = for you to work with you without being like, if you don't, I'll kill your family.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:26.879
    | text      = Now what I want to understand, maybe I don't, maybe it's too complicated, but what is that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.080
    | text      = for each of these houses?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:33.840
    | text      = I get that one of them, whether it's Harkonnen or Atreides, well, I guess Atreides, they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:39.480
    | text      = can fight really well because of the weirding way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:43.279
    | text      = And then also both of them are involved with Arrakis and the spice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:46.879
    | text      = But there are other houses and I don't know what they do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.200
    | text      = I mean, unfortunately I would say this is where we get into kind of the big problem
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:55.639
    | text      = with sci-fi during this time period.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:59.440
    | text      = This is where- You're paid by the word.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.759
    | text      = Well, that is a huge problem, but second only to the harsh eugenicism and fascism that runs
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.840
    | text      = through the core of most of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.320
    | text      = But you know, this is where we get the, this is the planet that does this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.039
    | text      = This is the planet that does this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.960
    | text      = This planet is where we get gemstones from.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:20.240
    | text      = This planet is where we get our stuff from.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.399
    | text      = So every great house has essentially a monopoly on like one kind of trade group thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:29.440
    | text      = And then if you're a economic group that has a monopoly on that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:33.000
    | text      = So essentially every aspect of the political sphere is like this idea of if you have an
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:37.940
    | text      = economic monopoly on one thing that everybody wants, then you have enough power to influence
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:44.120
    | text      = everything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.120
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:46.120
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:47.120
    | text      = That makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.120
    | text      = I mean, it doesn't make sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:49.120
    | text      = It wouldn't work, but it makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.120
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.120
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:52.120
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:53.120
    | text      = It's not like a- It makes enough sense for sci-fi.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:54.120
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:55.120
    | text      = That was a great way of putting it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.120
    | text      = Close enough for jazz.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Sensible enough for sci-fi.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:58.120
    | text      = Good enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:59.120
    | text      = Good enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:00.120
    | text      = So I, overall, I'll just give you, I guess, a broad-

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = I thought it was good in the same way that I thought the first one was good, but it did

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:39.900
    | text      = That's one of my favorite things about sci-fi period, is just half the time you're like,

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:51.539
    | text      = It's a daddy long legs.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I still don't think I understand what the Bene Gesserit want.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = The Bene Gesserit, so what's actually interesting about this question is that this is maybe

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = the moral question of the entire series.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:42.380
    | text      = If you want a world without conflict, a world without war, if you want to end people fighting

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = each other, what are you doing?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:06.940
    | text      = The story that you can read from Dune can be far more straightforward because Dune could
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Yeah.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:43.539

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:51.739

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:03.460

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Fair enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:26.940
    | text      = And Dune is a book, I would say almost entirely about religion and God.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:31.900
    | text      = Well, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:33.320
    | text      = And that's the part that's really difficult because it's also like a political story and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:37.019
    | text      = it's also like a hero's journey type story, but it is just so complicated that multiple
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:46.780
    | text      = people know that what they're doing is bullshit or kind of know that what they're doing is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:51.699
    | text      = bullshit and still do it, but also what they're doing isn't bullshit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:59.659
    | text      = So that is the problem with making time a character in your story, because if time is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:06.460
    | text      = a character, then that means people's decisions can then be evaluated on results later on,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:14.139
    | text      = upon later on, upon later on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:16.380
    | text      = So if you're going to live with time as a character, then here's what you can run up
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:21.659
    | text      = against while you're writing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:23.099
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:24.099
    | text      = So say I've got a character named Itler.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:26.219
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:27.219
    | text      = And he has a vision.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:28.579
    | text      = This is while, you know, his terrible country, Ermany, is under horrible oppression.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:33.500
    | text      = All these people are pissed off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:35.260
    | text      = Everybody's miserable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:36.260
    | text      = He has this vision from real ass God, real ass God, the real one, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:42.119
    | text      = That says, if you don't do this, then Germany will go away forever and ever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:48.340
    | text      = But if you do this, you will be a monster, but eventually you'll be part of the world
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:54.019
    | text      = leadership.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:56.019
    | text      = Eventually your country will be part of the nations of nations.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:58.940
    | text      = Eventually you'll be a leader economically, even despite all of that horrifying shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:03.179
    | text      = But you will live forever as a monster.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:05.219
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:06.219
    | text      = So now you have that question.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:08.179
    | text      = You don't have, am I a good person if I commit a genocide?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:12.099
    | text      = You have a, am I a good person if I commit a smaller genocide?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:16.059
    | text      = There will always, if time is a character, then your problem is always going to be the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:21.940
    | text      = trolley problem for every decision you make.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:25.179
    | text      = If you're Paul Atreides, okay, so I go on a tear and kill everybody in the universe
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:31.940
    | text      = and become the emperor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:33.500
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:34.500
    | text      = I don't kill everybody.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:35.500
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:36.500
    | text      = You know, there's plenty of people left.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:37.500
    | text      = I just killed a bunch of people who would have lived if I hadn't, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:41.579
    | text      = But if he doesn't exist, then a bunch of people are going to kill a bunch of people anyways.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:45.860
    | text      = The only difference is agency.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:47.780
    | text      = The only difference is in this story, it is definitively Paul's fault and Paul could choose
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:54.820
    | text      = to keep all of those people alive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:56.820
    | text      = But here's the thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:58.059
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:59.179
    | text      = So if Paul just died in the sword fight with a bald guy, how does everyone end up dying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = then?

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:10.539
    | text      = Well, that's the problem there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:11.980
    | text      = If he dies in a sword fight with bald guy, bald guy's kid is going to become the Kwisatz

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:16.739
    | text      = The Bene Gesserit are probably going to be able to control that kid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:19.219
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:20.219
    | text      = That kid will also become the emperor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:21.380
    | text      = And so we'll have the Kwisatz Haderach being the emperor anyways.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:24.739
    | text      = Only it won't be Jessica's son, it'll be Feyd-Roth's son.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:28.780
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Yeah.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:30.780
    | text      = Seems arbitrary.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:31.780
    | text      = It's very arbitrary.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:32.780
    | text      = That's also the problem with religion, my man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:36.059
    | text      = Paul, he has the agency and he has the choice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = The end result is bad for everyone no matter what.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = So there's a part of me that worries that it's like someone has given me a little bit
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:49.220
    | text      = immediately rejecting the idea, whenever I read Dune at like eight, of how silly this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:56.979

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:22.140

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
